line.comment: * Add-Ons 1.13: Only virus research requires time. Worm research (to hack stations) is unused. Port research is instant.
* Check if this station is a hacking station. If not, then reinitialize back to research station.
* Add-Ons 1.13: It is possible for research to be in progress while joining the OCV. If that happens, then:
* 1. $cost.credits.per is the progress per minute. This must be converted into a red crystal amount.
* 2. With the red crystal amount, multiply it back by its average price. This will return the true progress per minute.
* Research progress. Calculate the amount of progress per minute.
* OCV: pay with red crystals, but keep progress in credits.
* This is to ensure consistency with migration (when player joins the OCV) if research is in progress.
* Add this tick's budget into the credit remainder pool.
* Spend as many red crystals as possible.
* Special case: final small tail below 1 red crystal.
